title: Update to Nonprofit Security Grants as Legislators in Sacramento Consider State Budget
description: SAN DIEGO, CA – San Diego City Councilmembers Marni von Wilpert, Chair of the Public Safety Committee, and Raul Campillo, Vice Chair of the Public Safety Committee, will hold a press briefing to give an update on Governor Gavin Newsom’s inclusion of $40 million in his revised state budget to support security enhancements for nonprofit organizations that have historically been targets of hate-motivated violence and attacks.  The update comes as the California legislature votes on Governor Newsom’s budget, and after the tragic shooting at the Islamic Center of San Diego. Councilmembers von Wilpert and Campillo will discuss their urging of the California State Legislature to pass the $40 million Security Grant Program. This funding is what Councilmembers von Wilpert and Campillo advocated for earlier this year following the rise in hate-motivated violence targeting communities and religious institutions across California and the nation.
